overview: Force Drain is a adept-level dark side technique classified under Drain. Siphons the life energy and Force connection from a victim, transferring their vitality to the wielder to restore strength or extend their own power. Darth Nihilus became a wound in the Force itself, draining entire worlds to sustain his hollow existence.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Drain across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Sith Empire · Clone Wars established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Drain into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for drain specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Drain alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The dark side amplifies this power through passion, anger, and the will to dominate — at the cost of corruption and suffering.
significance:
Force Drain exemplifies how drain abilities shape Force doctrine on the dark side. At adept mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Drain could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Drain remains a benchmark of drain proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
